intro: In Tarren Mill, Melisara wants the Crushridge ogres thinned out before any real blow is struck against Mug'Thol, whose ogres now hold the Ruins of Alterac. You are sent to cut down Crushridge maulers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.
After softening them up, we'll proceed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I note that your task is unfinished, friend. Shall I inform Sharlindra of your ineptitude?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The snow blooms red with the blood of the ogres, but we cannot cease our efforts until the spirit and numbers of the Crushridge have been crushed and ground into the dirt and snow.
